decisions.reason: The client accepts the preceding proposal to custom-fabricate the raised base, adding a sourcing decision relevant to component selection alongside the existing custom-spout decision.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: This is the idea. I want the base to be five and a half inches tall so that our 12oz cups fit under the spouts. I want the machine to fit and sit on top of it perfectly. Edge to edge.

decisions.reason: The base dimensions provide cup clearance without changing the spouts' geometry, orientation, appearance, construction, or beverage-quality constraints.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the base height, cup clearance, and edge-to-edge footprint constraint.
The raised-base sourcing and dimensions do not change the whisk configuration, attachment, operating depth, or rotation criteria.

Raising the mixer for cup clearance does not change valve operation, gravity-based dispensing, flow behavior, or the dispensing sequence.
The base fabrication decision does not alter the mixing splash target or any high-speed splash-mitigation requirement.
Message 130 establishes base dimensions and fit but does not change machine wording, placard placement, or placard sides.
The base dimensions and sourcing exception do not modify the established DJ-turntable-inspired visual identity.
The raised platform does not change bowl removal, swapping, cleaning access, or clearance from the whisk and motor assembly.
